 Luis Miguel Branco Godinho, born on November 18, 1985 in Borba, Évora, Portugal, is a 39-year-old Portuguese football referee. He belongs to the Évora Football Association and has been an international referee since 2017. Throughout his career, he has officiated notable matches in the Portuguese Primeira Liga and European competitions. For example, on January 4, 2025, he refereed the match between Benfica and Sporting Braga, which ended with a 1-2 victory for Braga. Regarding his refereeing style, Godinho is known for being strict and rigorous in enforcing the rules, maintaining a strong control of the game. He has been involved in controversial decisions that have sparked debate in the media and among fans.Furthermore, he has been appointed to high-profile matches, including finals and classic Portuguese football games, highlighting his recognition and confidence in the refereeing field.
